items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: No, uh, unfortunately, Louis had to stay in Rome. He wasn't up to par, you know.

ctx.x: Well, did you cut Louis or did he cut you?

No, uh, unfortunately, Louis had to stay in Rome. He wasn't up to par, you know. He was taking a solo in Rome. He was in the hospital, I believe. But you did, those guys sat in with you some of them over there? Well, uh, we played, uh, we played as, uh, uh, Bill Bailey and Ella did a vocal for us. And, uh, Oscar Pettiford, uh, he's a terrific bass man. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
Oscar Pettiford now. We're talking about him.
